name: Right Click Disable OR Ban
author: A WP Life

sections.description:
Right Click Ban helps website owners protect their content from unauthorized copying. Whether you run a photography website, blog, or any content-driven site, this tool gives you control over how visitors interact with your pages.

When someone tries to right-click on your website, this tool blocks the context menu from appearing. You can also show a custom message letting visitors know that copying is not allowed.

What Can You Protect?

  • Right Click Menu – Block the context menu for visitors, admins, or both
  • F12 Key – Block the F12 key to prevent opening developer tools
  • Text Selection – Prevent visitors from selecting and copying text
  • Image Dragging – Stop images from being dragged and saved
  • Link Dragging – Prevent links from being dragged to bookmarks
  • Analytics – Track protection events to see how your content is being protected

Pro Features

Upgrade to Right Click Bann and Content Protection Pro

Right Click Bann and Content Protection Pro Live Demo

  • IP Blocking – Block specific IP addresses and ranges
  • Country Blocking – Block visitors from specific countries
  • Spam Bot Blocking – Automatically block 40+ known bad bots
  • Rate Limiting – Stop aggressive scrapers
  • Keyboard Shortcuts – Block Ctrl+C, Ctrl+U, Ctrl+S, Ctrl+P
  • DevTools Detection – Detect when browser DevTools is opened
  • Custom Modal Popup – Beautiful styled modals instead of alerts
  • Print Protection – Block Ctrl+P and printing
  • Per-Page Settings – Override protection per page/post
  • CSV Export – Export analytics to CSV

How It Works

After activation, head to the Right Click Disable menu in your dashboard. You will find simple toggle options:

  1. Disable right click for visitors
  2. Disable right click for admin
  3. Show or hide alert message
  4. Customize your alert message text
  5. Prevent text selection
  6. Stop image dragging
  7. Stop link dragging
  8. Block F12 key

Each option works independently. You can enable just one feature or combine them based on your needs.

Who Should Use This?

  • Photographers who want to protect their images
  • Bloggers protecting original articles
  • Artists showcasing portfolios
  • Business owners with proprietary content
  • Anyone who wants basic content protection

Browser Support

This tool works on all major browsers including Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and Opera. Special care has been taken to ensure Safari compatibility.

Lightweight Design

No external scripts or libraries are loaded. The protection code is minimal and runs only when needed, keeping your site fast.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Search for “Right Click Ban”
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate
  4. Navigate to Right Click Disable in your admin menu
  5. Configure your protection settings
  6. Click Save Settings

You can also upload the plugin manually:

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the zip file and click Install Now
  4. Activate and configure from the Right Click Disable menu
sections.faq:
How do I protect my site from right clicking?

Go to Settings, enable “Disable Right Click For Visitors”, and save. Visitors will no longer see the context menu when they right click.

Can I still right click as an admin?

Yes. Keep “Disable Right Click For Admin” disabled. You will have full access while visitors are blocked.

Will this show a message when someone tries to right click?

You can choose. Enable “Show Alert Message” and write your own custom text. Or disable it for silent blocking.

Can I block the F12 key?

Yes, enable “Disable F12 Key” in the Content Protection settings.

Will this slow down my website?

No. The code is lightweight and loads only on pages where protection is active. There are no external dependencies.

Does this work on mobile phones?

Yes. Long-press context menus are blocked on mobile devices too.

Is Safari browser supported?

Yes. The tool has been tested and optimized for Safari on both Mac and iOS.

Will this completely prevent content theft?

No tool can guarantee complete protection. Determined users can find workarounds. This tool adds a layer of protection that stops casual copying.

Does this affect SEO?

No. Search engine bots can still crawl and index your content normally.
